description: Twelve small, self-contained Node.js repo tasks. Each task starts from tasks/<id>/repo, the agent edits it, and success is decided ONLY by the hidden node:test files in tasks/<id>/check (copied in after the agent finishes) plus must_exist. tasks/<id>/solution is a reference answer used by the self-test; it is never shown to an agent.

tasks.title: Fix an off-by-one bug
tasks.prompt: src/range.js exports sumRange(from, to), which must return the sum of every integer from `from` to `to` with BOTH ends inclusive (sumRange(1, 3) === 6, sumRange(5, 5) === 5) and 0 when from > to. It currently returns the wrong value. Fix it.

tasks.title: Implement slugify
tasks.prompt: Implement slugify(text) in src/slugify.js. Rules: strip accents ("Café" -> "cafe"), lowercase, replace every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 with a single '-', and trim leading/trailing '-'. A string with no letters or digits returns ''. Examples: 'Hello World' -> 'hello-world', 'Rock & Roll!!  Forever' -> 'rock-roll-forever', 'a--b__c' -> 'a-b-c'.

tasks.title: Implement a strict duration parser
tasks.prompt: Implement parseDuration in src/duration.js exactly as specified in README.md: return the number of seconds for strings like '45s', '1h30m', '2d', '1d2h3m4s' (units d, h, m, s, in that order, each at most once, integer amounts) and throw a RangeError for anything else, including '', unknown units, repeated or out-of-order units, decimals and any whitespace.

tasks.title: Roman numeral conversion both ways
tasks.prompt: Implement toRoman(n) and fromRoman(s) in src/roman.js using standard subtractive notation (4 = 'IV', 1994 = 'MCMXCIV'). toRoman must throw a RangeError for anything that is not an integer from 1 to 3999. fromRoman(toRoman(n)) must equal n for every n from 1 to 3999.

tasks.title: Make deepMerge pure and recursive
tasks.prompt: deepMerge(target, source) in src/merge.js must return a NEW object and never mutate either argument. Plain objects merge recursively; arrays and all other values from source replace target's value; a key whose source value is undefined keeps target's value. The current implementation is shallow and mutates target. Fix it.

tasks.title: Teach the CSV parser RFC 4180 quoting
tasks.prompt: parseCsv(text) in src/csv.js returns rows as arrays of strings but breaks on quoted fields. Make it follow RFC 4180: fields may be wrapped in double quotes, a quoted field may contain commas, newlines and doubled quotes ("" means one "), lines end in \n or \r\n, empty fields are empty strings, and a trailing line break does not create an extra empty row.

tasks.title: Semver precedence comparison
tasks.prompt: Implement compareSemver(a, b) in src/semver.js, returning -1, 0 or 1 for MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH[-prerelease] strings according to the semver.org 2.0.0 precedence rules (numeric core comparison; a prerelease sorts before its release; dot-separated prerelease identifiers compare numerically when both are numeric, numeric identifiers sort before alphanumeric ones, otherwise compare as ASCII strings; when all shared identifiers are equal the shorter list sorts first). Build metadata is out of scope.

tasks.title: LRU cache class
tasks.prompt: Finish the LruCache class in src/lru.js: constructor(capacity) throws a RangeError unless capacity is a positive integer; get(key) returns the value or undefined and marks the key most-recently used; set(key, value) inserts or updates (also marking it most-recently used) and evicts the least-recently used entry when over capacity; has(key) does NOT change recency; a read-only `size` property returns the number of entries.

tasks.title: Rename a function across files
tasks.prompt: Rename the exported function calc in src/pricing.js to computeTotal and update every caller. After the change, no file under src/ may contain the identifier calc, pricing.js must no longer export calc, and behaviour must be unchanged.

tasks.title: Release notes and version bump
tasks.prompt: Cut release 1.1.0 of this package: bump the version to 1.1.0 in package.json and in the VERSION constant in src/index.js, and create CHANGELOG.md at the repo root with a '## [1.1.0]' section (above any older section) that mentions the new `--verbose` flag.

tasks.title: Add a --lines flag to a CLI
tasks.prompt: src/wc.js is a CLI that prints the number of words in the file given as its argument. Add a --lines flag that prints the number of newline characters instead; the flag may appear before or after the file path. Without the flag behaviour is unchanged. Any other argument that starts with -- must print an error to stderr and exit with a non-zero status.

tasks.title: Retry with exponential backoff
tasks.prompt: Implement retry(fn, { attempts = 3, delayMs = 100 } = {}) in src/retry.js as documented in its header comment: call the async fn until it resolves, at most `attempts` calls in total, waiting delayMs, then 2*delayMs, then 4*delayMs ... between calls; resolve with fn's value or reject with the LAST error.
